'''Durund''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Durund once witnessed a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] use a [[Espo grenade mortar|grenade mortar]] on striking laborers.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
